evidence.r1: Only the top nav pill, the top-right toggle, and the three bottom pills (colour/lens/order) use glass; the wood-table hero photo and the lens-menu list rows are plain content, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r2: The nav pill, toggle, and three bottom pills sit in clearly separate screen regions with no overlap, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r3: Five glass elements total (nav, toggle, colour swatch, lens selector, order) across the whole viewport, each tied to a distinct task, shot-full-light.
evidence.r4: Every pill reads as the same moderately frosted, backdrop-tinted regular glass in both shot-fv-light and shot-fv-dark; no separate barely-blurred clear surface appears.
evidence.r5: No clear-variant glass is used anywhere on the page, so the clear-over-media-with-dimming requirement is never triggered, both schemes.
evidence.r6: The Order pill's warm cast in shot-fv-light matches the toggle's cast over the same wood tone, and both read neutral grey in shot-fv-dark, so no control carries an applied tint beyond backdrop sampling.
evidence.r7: All five pills show blur and specular edge highlighting over the wood grain in both schemes rather than a flat fill.
evidence.r8: Nav pill, toggle, and bottom pills are all capsules (radius = height/2); the lens-menu panel in shot-menu-light is a fixed-radius rounded rectangle.
evidence.r9: The checked '45 mm f/1.4' row inside the lens menu (shot-menu-light) sits inset from the panel's rounded corners without a pinched or flared arc.
evidence.r10: The floating nav, toggle and bottom pills are all capsules; no small dense rectangular control appears to contradict this, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r11: The nav links share one pill and the toggle is its own group at top; the colour, lens and order controls are three separate pills at the bottom — each region stays at or under three groups, shot-full-light.
evidence.r12: The nav pill holds only text links; the toggle, colour, lens and order pills each hold one control type, never a mixed text-plus-icon pairing, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r13: Glass is applied at each pill's outer boundary; the text and colour dots inside sit on one shared surface rather than being individually glassed, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r14: The bottom three pills keep a visible gap between them (colour vs lens vs order) rather than touching or merging, shot-full-light.
evidence.r15: shot-full-light/dark are pixel-identical to shot-fv-light/dark, so the page never shows content scrolling under a bar; no edge fade is built or demonstrated.
evidence.r16: Every pill sits over the busy wood-grain photo, never a flat colour field, in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Only the hero photograph, not text or list content, sits beneath the floating pills at rest in shot-fv-light/dark; no informational content is trapped under glass.
evidence.r18: Nav and pill text (black in light, white in dark) reads clearly against the frosted pill fill in both shot-fv-light and shot-fv-dark.
evidence.r19: shot-reduced only demonstrates the transparency switch (pills turn solid); no increased-contrast or reduced-motion state is shown for this page.
evidence.r20: The wood-table photo fills all four edges of the 1440x900 frame in shot-fv-light/dark with only pills floating over it.
evidence.r21: The photo extends edge-to-edge with no sidebar and no hard seam anywhere the pills float, shot-full-light/dark.
evidence.r22: The lens-menu panel in shot-menu-light/dark has no added dark scrim or border beyond its own glass edge; the rest of the frame is unchanged.
evidence.r23: Captures are static; only the lens menu's position directly above the '45 mm f/1.4' control (shot-menu-light) can be checked, not materialisation, morphing or press feedback.
evidence.r24: Nav text, toggle icon and pill labels are black/white monochrome in both schemes; the only colour on the page is the wood photo itself.
evidence.r25: Black nav/pill text sits over mid-brown wood in shot-fv-light and white text over the same wood darkened in shot-fv-dark; neither is a close hue match.
